usedFor: Shopify holds the store records, and LeadConnector receives a contact through “Create Contact” after “New Company”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Company” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A new company is a new account, so a contact in LeadConnector lets sales follow it.

watchOut: “Segment Updated” and “Collection Updated” fire on updates, so one record can run “Create Contact” again.
